technicalAssessment.summaryRo: The requested investment reaches 100.00% on the green indicator (passes the threshold). fundingRecommendation.farmerExplanationRo: You gain 421 EUR by choosing the green credit instead of the classic one, over the whole life of the credit. The liquidity gap in the first conversion year, including the credit instalments, is 36,020 EUR, against an APIA pre-financing of 40,320 EUR: it is covered. In conversion year 2 the gap (45,579 EUR) exceeds the pre-financing (40,320 EUR): we will discuss treasury support (F5).

The liquidity gap in the first conversion year, including the credit instalments, is 36,020 EUR, against an APIA pre-financing of 40,320 EUR: it is covered.
